fr.sorbonne_u.components.utils.tests

Class TestScenario

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.utils.tests.TestScenario
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class TestScenario
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
    The class TestScenario implements a test scenario to be executed by components.

    Description

    A test scenario describe a run were some of the actions taken by components are imposed by the scenario. Hence, at the heart of a test scenario, there is a sequence of test steps performed by components, which are identified by their reflection inbound port URI. Each test step is defined by the class TestStep.

    The time management used in test steps and test scenarios is based on the time line provided by the class Instant, hence test steps are planned at instants using this class. A test scenario has a start instant and an end instant. The time of occurrence of a test step is an instant between the start and end instants. Steps are provided by an array of TestStep that must be ordered by ascending instants of occurrence. To help constructing complex scenarios intertwining actions performed by different components, the array of steps contains all of the actions in a scenario, including all components the scenario will involve. However, the execution of the test scenario makes advances per component.

    Optional beginning and ending messages can also be provided.

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       testSteps != null && testSteps.length > 0
 invariant       participantsURIs != null && participantsURIs.size() > 0
 invariant       startInstant != null
 invariant       endInstant != null
 invariant       startInstant.isBefore(endInstant)
 invariant       nextSteps != null
 invariant       nextSteps.size() == participantsURIs.size()
 invariant       nextSteps.keySet().stream().allMatch(uri -> participantsURIs.contains(uri))
 invariant       nextSteps.values().stream().allMatch(index -> index >= 0 && index <= instance.testSteps.length)

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant
